subject: OpenAI asks Congress for mandatory capability-based national safety rules

metrics.headline: OpenAI asks Congress for mandatory capability-based national safety rules
metrics.body_excerpt: OpenAI is now asking Congress for mandatory, capability-based national safety rules (testing, independent assessments, cyber protections, incident reporting) after recent rogue-agent incidents. This is a reversal from earlier light-touch lobbying and raises the odds of federal rules rather than a patchwork of state laws.
